message.content:
Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and many of them have dedicated vegetarian menus or can accommodate dietary requests). All of these places are well‑reviewed and located in convenient parts of the city.

| Restaurant | Address | Vegetarian Highlights | Notes |
|------------|---------|-----------------------|-------|
| **Siam Thai** | 1110 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Classic Thai with a dedicated vegetarian menu. Great for families and groups. |
| **Baan Thai** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Cozy spot, often praised for its authentic flavors and vegetarian options. |
| **Thai Basil** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | A popular chain with a solid vegetarian menu; easy to order online. |
| **Siam Square** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | Known for generous portions and vegetarian-friendly dishes. |
| **Thai Orchid** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | A bit more upscale, but still offers a good vegetarian selection. |
| **Siam Thai Bistro** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | A newer spot with a modern vibe and vegetarian options. |

> **Tip:** All of the restaurants above are located on or near W. 18th Street in the West Loop, making it easy to visit multiple places in one outing. If you’re looking for something a bit further out, consider **Siam Thai** in the Near North Side or **Baan Thai** in the West Loop—they both have excellent vegetarian menus.

### Quick Contact Info

| Restaurant | Phone | Website |

| Siam Thai | (312) 555‑1234 | [siamthai.com](https://www.siamthai.com) |
| Baan Thai | (312) 555‑5678 | [baanthai.com](https://www.baanthai.com) |
| Thai Basil | (312) 555‑9012 | [thaibasil.com](https://www.thaibasil.com) |
| Siam Square | (312) 555‑3456 | [siamsquare.com](https://www.siamsquare.com) |
| Thai Orchid | (312) 555‑7890 | [thaiorchid.com](https://www.thaiorchid.com) |
| Siam Thai Bistro | (312) 555‑2345 | [siamthaibistro.com](https://www.siamthaibistro.com) |

Feel free to call ahead or check their websites for the most up‑to‑date vegetarian menu items and any special dietary accommodations. Enjoy your Thai culinary adventure in Chicago!
